use_when: to show the status of an item, such as a row in a table.
Use Warning for items that are waiting, such as Pending or Awaiting review.
Use Positive for finished items, such as Resolved, and Negative for failed items, such as Rejected.
Use Info for work in progress, and Update for items that were changed or are new.

dont_use_when.when: as a button. A badge is not clickable.
as a tab or a filter.
for long text. Keep labels to one or two words.
Do not choose a Type for its color. Choose it for its meaning.
Do not change the color, padding or corner radius of a badge.

best_practice: Use the same label for the same status across every screen.
Write labels in sentence case, such as "In progress".
Show only one badge per item.

variant_intent.type=Warning: Figma: items that are waiting, such as Pending or Awaiting review.
variant_intent.type=Positive: Figma: finished items, such as Resolved.
variant_intent.type=Negative: Figma: failed items, such as Rejected.
variant_intent.type=Update: Figma: items that were changed or are new.
variant_intent.type=Neutral: Renders the gray style (code). Figma does not describe a Neutral type.

a11y.fact: Renders a plain <span> with its label text, so the status is named in text and the badge is not focusable.
